title: How checks are written
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0006 no longer matches the current design.
decision: A check is written before the build by someone other than the work's builders, and frozen only once it has been seen to fail against work that does not satisfy it. A check binds the example's meaning, never wording the example did not fix; where a capability already defines correctness, the check delegates to it. Behaviour of agents is judged in use, never checked (0142).
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
